description: Markers, measurements and sections set in a viewer. 'document' holds the application's complete annotation document; markers and their observations are also stored as tables, so other tools need not parse it. Positions are in the scan's world frame.

acquisition.description: Node path of the ct_acquisition whose projection rows the observations refer to.

markers.description: One row per marker; time = when the document was saved.

position_source.description: 0 none, 1 triangulated from observations, 2 set in a volume slice.

observations.description: Number of projections the marker was set in.
Where a marker was set in a projection; time = the projection's time.

image_index.description: Sample in the detector's image series.

pixel.description: Column, row; pixel centres at integer values (pixel 0 spans -0.5 .. 0.5).
